outlook.discussion: 1. Western Central Pacific: Shower activity associated with a broad area of low pressure located near or just west of the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll, has become a little better organized since yesterday. Environmental conditions could support some continued slow development while the system crosses the Dateline and moves generally eastward to east-northeastward. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.
